sources.snippet: FlexiSLM model evaluation traces JSONL inference traces only (no generated WAVs). Each file is named after the model. Records follow the FlexiSLM eval trace schema (index, task, input, output, evaluation, metadata). Files flexislm_stage2_released.jsonl — FlexiSLM-7B Stage2 released checkpoint (ckpt-150000), 12.5 Hz in/out, flow-matching s2s on VoiceBench + OpenAudioBench.

sources.snippet: Spoken language models (SLMs) extend LLMs to speech input and output. Existing SLMs represent speech at fixed frame rates (e.g., 25 or 12.5 Hz), ignoring the time-varying information density of speech and offering limited flexibility to trade off quality for speed at inference time.
